_howToUse: Send this list to the supplier on the supplier chat or WhatsApp — most will fill it in and
attach an image pack the same day. Then: npm run product:add -- ./intake/jhumka.json
Ask in the same message: 'Please confirm in writing that I may use these product
images on my own website and Indian marketplace listings.' Keep the reply.
title: Ethnic Retro Carved Jhumka
tagline: Deep-carved dome with an oxidised antique finish
description: Long copy for the product page. Write your own — do not paste the supplier's, it is on every competing listing.

askTheSupplierFor.platingMaterial: What exactly is the plating — silver, rhodium, or lacquer over brass?
askTheSupplierFor.platingMicrons: Plating thickness in microns — decides how fast it wears
askTheSupplierFor.nickelFree: Yes or no. Matters for skin reaction and for EU-style claims
askTheSupplierFor.leadCadmium: Confirm compliance if you plan to claim it
askTheSupplierFor.dimensions: Length x width, and drop length for earrings
askTheSupplierFor.unitPriceFob: Per piece at your quantity, and the currency
askTheSupplierFor.hsCode: Usually 7117 for imitation jewellery — confirm, it sets your customs duty
askTheSupplierFor.countryOfOrigin: Mandatory on Indian listings and on the package
askTheSupplierFor.packaging: Polybag, box, card? Affects what you must re-pack
askTheSupplierFor.imagePack: High-resolution images: white background, detail, on-model, and scale shot

supplier: Supplier name or the supplier site store
